prompt: Workers check different chunks of log lines at the same time and send the number of each bad line over a channel. Lines 5 and 2 are bad, and either worker may report first. `summarize` takes the smallest reported number with `rx.iter().min()`. What does it return?
choices: Either Err(BadLine(2)) or Err(BadLine(5)), depending on timing
Ok with the counts of the good lines
explain: `min()` only looks at the numbers after all senders are done, so the order of arrival no longer matters. Reducing results in a fixed way is how you keep concurrent code deterministic.
